description: Incorporated in 1980, Lam Research Corporation is a Delaware corporation headquartered in Fremont, California, that maintains a network of facilities throughout Asia, Europe and the United States in order to meet the needs of its dynamic customer base. Its product portfolio spans deposition, including electrochemical deposition of copper and other metal films with its SABRE family, chemical vapor deposition and atomic layer deposition of tungsten and molybdenum with its ALTUS family, and dielectric films, together with related etch and clean technologies for wafer fabrication, and it provides the equipment and services used by semiconductor manufacturers to produce advanced devices.
